patient_persona.description: Leong Kok Wah, 68, male, retired tin-mine fitter from Ipoh; hypertension on amlodipine. Slow, gravelly Malaysian Mandarin with Cantonese colour.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Loh Chee Keong, Malaysian Chinese man in his 50s, GP in Ipoh. Friendly; Mandarin with English medical terms.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 梁先生，今天来是什么问题？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 医生，我这一两年小便越来越 slow，要站很久才出来。晚上要起身三四次，睡不好。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 小便完了，会不会觉得还没有完，还想再去？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 会啊，常常刚出来又要回去。有时候还会滴到裤子，很尴尬。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 有没有看到 blood？或者小便痛？Weight 有没有减少？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 没有血，也不痛。体重差不多，七十公斤。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 你有吃什么药吗？感冒药、药材、supplement 都算。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 血压药 amlodipine 5mg，早上一粒。晚上睡不着，有时候吃 allergy 药。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 这种 allergy 药是 antihistamine，会让 urine 更难出来，尽量不要吃。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 刚才做了 rectal exam，prostate 大，但是摸起来 smooth，没有硬块。像是 benign prostate enlargement，前列腺肥大。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 会不会是癌症？我有个朋友是 prostate cancer。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 我们会验血看 PSA，也做 urine test 和 kidney function test。Report 出来我再跟你解释。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 现在先开 tamsulosin 0.4mg，每天晚上睡前一粒。刚开始可能会 dizzy，起身要 slowly，don't rush。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 晚上起来那么多次，有什么办法吗？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 晚上七点以后少喝水，不要喝茶和 coffee。Two weeks 后回来看 report。

patient_persona.description: Haji Abdul Razak bin Mat Saad, 72, male, retired padi farmer from Alor Setar, Kedah; on Duodart and perindopril. Soft, slow Kedah Malay.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Anis Sofea binti Hashim, Malay woman in her 30s, medical officer at a Kedah health clinic. Respectful; Malay with some English.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Assalamualaikum, pak haji. Macam mana urine flow sekarang, lepas makan ubat tiga bulan?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Waalaikumsalam. Kencing lebih laju sikit, doktor. Malam bangun dua kali saja, dulu empat lima kali.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Alhamdulillah, bagus tu. Ada side effect tak? Pening ke?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Ada. Pagi-pagi bila bangun dari katil, kepala pusing. Minggu lepas hampir jatuh dalam bilik air.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Blood pressure pak haji masa duduk 128/76, standing turun jadi 102/64. That's postural hypotension, pak haji.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Duodart tu ada tamsulosin, boleh turunkan tekanan darah. Pak haji ada makan ubat darah tinggi lain?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Ada, perindopril 8mg pagi. Anak saya beli juga ubat herba untuk prostat dari pasar malam.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Ubat herba tu nama apa? Boleh bawa tunjuk minggu depan? Ada yang dicampur ubat lain.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Nanti saya suruh anak ambil gambar. Saya makan dua biji sehari.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Buat masa ni stop herba tu dulu. Perindopril saya reduce to 4mg. Duodart continue, one tablet at night, lepas makan.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Kalau bangun malam nak kencing, macam mana nak elak pening?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Duduk tepi katil dulu one minute, baru bangun. Pasang lampu kecil dalam toilet.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Baik, doktor. PSA saya bulan lepas macam mana?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: PSA 1.4. Duodart turunkan PSA separuh, jadi kita kira macam 2.8. Masih normal.

patient_persona.description: Joseph a/l Anthony, 65, male, retired schoolteacher from Butterworth, Penang; on tamsulosin for a year; brother had prostate cancer. Articulate, precise Malaysian Indian English.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Tan Boon Chye, Malaysian Chinese man in his 50s, urologist at a Penang hospital. Measured; English.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Mr Joseph, good to see you. We have your ultrasound and blood results today.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Yes doctor. The tamsulosin helped at first, but these last few months the stream lemah again.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Your prostate volume is 55ml, about three times normal. After you pass urine, 90ml still stays in the bladder.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Is that a lot? Should I be risau?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: It's moderately raised, not dangerous yet. Your kidney function is normal, creatinine 88.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Your PSA is 3.1. For your age and prostate size that fits BPH, and the rectal exam was smooth.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: My brother had prostate cancer at seventy. That's always at the back of my mind.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Faham, encik. With that family history, kita ulang PSA dalam six months. Kalau naik cepat, we'll do an MRI.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Since the prostate is large, I'll add dutasteride 0.5mg once a day. It shrinks the prostate slowly, about a quarter over six months.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Six months? Lama juga tu. Any side effects I should know about?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Some men get lower libido or less semen. It also halves your PSA reading, so always tell any doctor you're on it.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Alright. And kalau ubat tak jalan, then operation?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Then we'd discuss TURP or newer options like Rezum. But let's give dutasteride a fair chance first.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Terima kasih, doctor. I'll continue the tamsulosin as usual then.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Yes, both at night. Jumpa lagi in six months with a repeat PSA and bladder scan.

patient_persona.description: Pak Wan Ismail bin Wan Ali, 78, male, retired fisherman from Kuala Terengganu; admitted with urinary retention after cold medicine. Hard of hearing, loud Terengganu Malay.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Lim Jia Hui, Malaysian Chinese woman in her 30s, surgical medical officer at a Terengganu hospital. Patient; speaks slow, clear Malay with English terms.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Selamat pagi, pak cik. Saya doktor surgery. Macam mana hari ni? Masih sakit perut bawah?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Hah? Oh, dah tak sakit dah, doktor. Semalam macam nak pecah perut, urine tak keluar langsung.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Semalam kita pasang catheter, keluar 1.2 liter air kencing. Pundi kencing pak cik penuh sangat.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Banyak tu. Never jadi macam ni. Selalu kencing lambat je.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Sebelum ni, ada makan ubat selsema atau cough mixture?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Ada. Anak bagi ubat selsema dari farmasi, sebab hidung tersumbat. Makan tiga hari.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Ubat tu ada pseudoephedrine. Untuk orang yang prostat besar, ubat tu boleh buat kencing tersekat terus.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Laa, ubat selsema pun boleh jadi macam ni?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Boleh, pak cik. Next time beritahu pharmacist yang pak cik ada masalah prostate.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Creatinine semalam 140, hari ni dah turun 110. Kidney function is okay, no damage.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Saya start tamsulosin 0.4mg, one tablet at night. Lusa kita remove catheter, tengok boleh kencing sendiri ke tak.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Kalau tak boleh kencing juga, macam mana?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Kita pasang balik catheter, pak cik bawa balik rumah, dan kita bincang pembedahan TURP.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Pembedahan? Saya dah tua, takut.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Tak apa, kita tengok dulu lusa. Ramai boleh kencing sendiri lepas berhenti ubat selsema dan makan tamsulosin.

patient_persona.description: Tay Ah Seng, 70, male, retired goldsmith in Melaka; BPH on tamsulosin and finasteride, type 2 diabetes on metformin. Cheerful, jokes, Melaka Mandarin with Hokkien words.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Chua Li Ting, Malaysian Chinese woman in her 40s, family medicine specialist in Melaka. Warm; Mandarin with English terms.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 医生，我来拿药。Tamsulosin 跟 finasteride 都快吃完了。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 好。最近 urine flow 怎样？白天和晚上都跟我讲一下。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 白天还好，出得比较顺。可是晚上还是起来三次，我太太都被我吵醒。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 上次给你的 bladder diary，有记录吗？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 有，我孙女帮我写的。你看，晚上的量比白天还多。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 你晚上的小便占了一天的四成多。这个叫 nocturnal polyuria，不完全是 prostate 的 problem。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 那是什么引起的？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 可能是晚上 drink too much，或者脚肿，躺下水分就回流。你 dinner 后喝什么？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 饭后一定喝一壶中国茶，然后看电视吃西瓜。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 茶和西瓜都改到 afternoon 吧。晚上六点以后少喝，傍晚把脚抬高半个钟。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 你的血糖也要看。HbA1c 这次 8.1，比上次高。血糖高也会多尿。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 最近华人新年，吃太多年饼了，哈哈。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 过年难免。Metformin 照吃，我帮你转介 dietitian。两种 prostate 药继续，开三个月。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 好，谢谢医生。Three months 后再见。

patient_persona.description: Saraswathy a/p Govindasamy, 58, female, school canteen operator in Klang; type 2 diabetes for 14 years, hypertension on losartan. Warm, talkative Malaysian Indian English with Malay words.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Mohd Faizal bin Ahmad, Malay man in his 40s, nephrologist at a Klang Valley hospital. Precise, calm; English.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Good morning, Mrs Saraswathy. Your GP referred you because your kidney numbers went up. Let's go through it.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Morning doctor. Yes, the klinik called me, said potassium high, must see specialist quickly. I was so scared.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Your potassium is 5.8, normal is up to 5.0. Your eGFR, the kidney filter, is 38. Three months ago it was 46.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Why it drop so fast? Every day I makan all my ubat.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Let's check. Any pain killers recently? Even from the pharmacy?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: My knee very sakit, so the kedai ubat gave me diclofenac. Sehari dua biji, dah sebulan.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: That's likely a big part of it. Diclofenac can damage the kidneys, especially together with losartan. Please stop it today.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Then for my lutut sakit what can I take?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Paracetamol 1 gram up to three times a day is safe. We'll ask physio to see your knee.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: For potassium, kurangkan pisang, air kelapa and potatoes. Also, do you use a salt substitute?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Aiyo, yes. My daughter bought the low sodium garam, I use for masak in the canteen.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: That salt is mostly potassium chloride. Switch back to normal salt, just use less of it.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: I'm also starting dapagliflozin 10mg once a day. It protects the kidney and helps your diabetes.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Okay doctor. Bila kena datang balik?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Two weeks, for a repeat potassium and kidney test. Kalau rasa lemah sangat or jantung berdebar, terus pergi emergency.

patient_persona.description: Encik Zainal Abidin bin Yahya, 63, male, retired postman from Kampung Baru, Kuala Lumpur; diabetic kidney disease; his late brother was on dialysis. Worried, deliberate KL Malay.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Wong Pei Shan, Malaysian Chinese woman in her 40s, nephrologist in Kuala Lumpur. Gentle; speaks Malay with English terms.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Encik Zainal, keputusan darah bulan ni dah ada. eGFR sekarang 18, bulan lepas 21.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Makin turun lah ye, doktor. Saya dah jaga makan, kurang salt.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Encik dah buat yang terbaik. But the kidney is already stage 4, so kita kena mula bincang dialysis preparation.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Dialysis? Saya takut, doktor. Arwah abang saya dulu cuci darah, susah sangat.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Faham. Bukan mula sekarang, tapi kena bersedia. Biasanya bila eGFR bawah 10, atau ada simptom.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: First step, buat fistula di tangan kiri. Kena buat early, because it takes two to three months to mature.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Tangan kiri tu tak boleh ambil darah lagi ke?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Betul. Mulai hari ni, jangan ambil darah atau pasang drip di tangan kiri. Beritahu nurse.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Hemoglobin encik 9.1, that's why cepat penat. Kita start erythropoietin injection, once a week.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Boleh inject sendiri kat rumah?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Boleh, nurse akan ajar. Bicarbonate darah pun rendah, jadi saya bagi sodium bicarbonate 1 gram, sehari tiga kali.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Ada pilihan lain selain cuci darah kat hospital?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Ada, peritoneal dialysis yang buat sendiri kat rumah, atau pemindahan buah pinggang. Minggu depan nurse akan terangkan semua.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Terima kasih, doktor. Minggu depan saya bawa isteri sekali.

patient_persona.description: Wong Siew Hua, 66, female, retired rubber smallholder in Sibu, Sarawak; hypertension and CKD. Soft Foochow-accented Mandarin, polite but stubborn.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Lau Kah Ming, Malaysian Chinese man in his 40s, physician at a Sibu hospital clinic. Patient, direct; Mandarin with English terms.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 黄阿姨，这次验血的 creatinine 是 190，上次是 140。肾功能差了不少。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 怎么会这样？我每天都有吃 blood pressure 药。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 最近有没有吃其他东西？中药、supplement、slimming tea 都算。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 我邻居介绍一个中药，说是补肾的，一包一包煮来喝。喝了两个月。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 有带来吗？有些中药含有会伤肾的 chemical，还有 heavy metal。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 有，我拍了照片。你看，包装上面都是中文。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 上面没有卫生部的 registration number，ingredients 也不清楚。我建议你马上 stop，不要再喝了。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 可是我喝了觉得精神比较好，晚上也比较少起来。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 我明白，但是 risk 很大。你的 kidney 只剩下差不多三成 function，要好好保护。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 血压今天 156/92，有点高。Amlodipine 从 5mg 加到 10mg，早上一粒。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 要不要吃什么药补肾？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 没有补肾的药。最重要是 control blood pressure，少盐，不要乱吃 painkiller 和药材。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 好吧，我听你的。那几包我拿去丢掉。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 很好。Six weeks 后再验血，看 creatinine 会不会回升一点。

patient_persona.description: Rosmah binti Hassan, 55, female, runs a kuih stall in Muar, Johor; hypertension, gout and CKD stage 3a. Quick, cheerful Johor Malay.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Arjun a/l Ramesh, Malaysian Indian man in his 30s, medical officer at a Muar health clinic. Friendly; Malay with English terms.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Doktor, saya nak ambil ubat bulanan. Ubat darah tinggi dengan ubat gout.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Boleh, puan. Gout ada serang lagi tak bulan ni?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Ada sekali, ibu jari kaki bengkak. Saya makan colchicine tiga biji sehari, empat hari.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: With your kidney, colchicine 0.5mg maximum two tablets a day, tiga hari saja. Lebih dari tu boleh cirit-birit teruk.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Oh, patutlah perut saya meragam hari tu.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Uric acid puan 520, masih tinggi. Kidney function, eGFR 52, stable macam dulu.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Allopurinol saya naikkan dari 100mg ke 200mg sehari. Naik pelan-pelan, supaya tak cetuskan gout.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Makanan pula, doktor? Saya jual kuih, selalu makan kuih sendiri, minum air manis.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Air manis dan air bergas boleh naikkan uric acid. Kurangkan jeroan, ikan bilis dan kerang.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Susah sikit, suami suka sangat kerang rebus. Jamu boleh makan tak? Kawan jual jamu untuk sendi.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Tolong elak jamu, puan. Ada jamu dicampur steroid atau ubat tahan sakit, bahaya untuk buah pinggang.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Baik lah. Ubat darah tinggi sama macam dulu?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Blood pressure 132/80, good. Losartan 50mg continue. Tiga bulan lagi kita cek darah.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Terima kasih, doktor.

patient_persona.description: Benedict Gumpil, 60, male, Kadazan retired land surveyor from Penampang, Sabah; type 2 diabetes and hypertension. Easygoing Sabahan English with Sabah Malay ('bah', 'kan').

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Nicole Tan Hui Wen, Malaysian Chinese woman in her 40s, nephrologist in Kota Kinabalu. Clear; English with some Malay.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Morning Mr Benedict. Your doctor sent you because of protein in the urine. How are you feeling generally?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Morning doctor. I feel okay bah. Only my ankles a bit bengkak in the evening.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Your urine albumin to creatinine ratio is 85, normal is below 3. So a lot of protein is leaking.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Is that very bad? The klinik said my eGFR still okay kan?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Your eGFR is 58, stage 3a. Tapi protein ni lebih bahaya. Maknanya kencing manis dan darah tinggi dah strain the kidney.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: What medicines are you on now?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Metformin 1 gram twice daily, gliclazide 80mg pagi, and losartan 50mg. Kadang-kadang I lupa the evening metformin lah.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Your blood pressure today is 148/88. I want it below 130. So losartan goes up to 100mg once a day.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: I'm also adding dapagliflozin 10mg in the morning. It reduces the protein leak and slows kidney decline.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Any side effect for that one, doktor?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: You'll pass more urine, and ada sikit risiko jangkitan kulat. Keep the area bersih dan kering.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: I also drink lihing and tapai at Kaamatan and weddings, and some beer on weekends. Must stop?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Occasionally is fine, one or two drinks maximum. More important is less salt, especially ikan masin and instant noodles.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Okay doctor, saya cuba. When to come back?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: One month, check potassium and kidney after the losartan increase. Bawa your home BP readings, ya.
